statement_verbatim:
statement: Every width condition in an `@media` query, `min-width`/`max-width` or the range syntax (`width >= 768px`,
  `768px <= width`), MUST use one of the breakpoints declared under `frontend.breakpoints` in `atdd-bun.yaml` (default
  480, 768, 1024, 1280). A `max-width` within 1px below a breakpoint (`767px`, `767.98px`) counts as that breakpoint,
  and `em`/`rem` convert at 16px. New in atdd-bun, strict.

statement: A `width` or `min-width` declaration, in a stylesheet, a `<style>` block, a `style` attribute or a JSX
  `style` object, MUST NOT exceed (with `rem` and `em` counted at 16px) the smallest viewport declared under `frontend.viewports`
  in `atdd-bun.yaml` (default 375px). New in atdd-bun, strict.

statement: Every full HTML document (an `.html`/`.htm` file, a `.tsx`/`.jsx` layout that renders `<html>`, or a
  `.ts`/`.js` template that builds one) MUST declare `<meta name="viewport">` whose content sets `width=device-width`,
  and MUST NOT block zoom with `user-scalable=no` or a `maximum-scale` below 2. New in atdd-bun, strict.

statement: >-
  A consumer that declares guarded flow router routes MUST have a runtime that READS the
  declaration it is given. An `FlowRouterRunner` constructed with a flow router YAML path MUST
  load that path and resolve from what it read; a `FlowRunner` MUST take the product capability order from the
  user/system flow definition. A runtime that stores the path and returns hardcoded values satisfies every
  text-level rule in this package and is not executing the plan — it is transcribing it.

statement: >-
  A full-stack Bun application MUST serve HTTP with `Bun.serve` and MUST NOT construct a server with
  Express, Fastify, Koa or `node:http`/`node:https` `createServer`. `Bun.serve` is the only server in
  this stack with access to Bun's native routing, WebSocket upgrade, streaming and `HTMLRewriter` —
  the last of which is how htmx fragments are transformed server-side. This is the Bun-stack
  realization of the agnostic "the application uses its runtime's native primitives rather than a
  compatibility shim" obligation, enforced by the `bun_fullstack_detector` family implementation on
  `atdd.workspace.bun`.

statement: >-
  A repository whose package manager is Bun MUST NOT carry `package-lock.json`, `yarn.lock` or
  `pnpm-lock.yaml` alongside `bun.lock`/`bun.lockb`. Two lockfiles mean two resolvers disagree about
  the dependency graph, and which one wins is decided by whichever command a developer or CI step
  happens to run. This is the Bun-stack realization of the agnostic "dependency resolution has one
  source of truth" obligation, enforced by the `bun_fullstack_detector` family implementation on
  `atdd.workspace.bun`.

statement: >-
  A Bun project containing TypeScript sources MUST have a typechecker it can run and MUST wire a
  no-emit typecheck into its check path — TypeScript (or an equivalent native preview) as a
  dependency, a `tsconfig.json`, and some script that runs a no-emit typecheck. Bun executes `.ts`
  by STRIPPING types; it transpiles and never checks, and it bundles no `tsc`. Absent this, a Bun
  stack is by default less type-safe than a tsc-based one.

statement: >-
  Source MUST NOT contain a secret literal — an AWS access key id, a PEM private-key header, or a password
  / api-key / token assigned a literal string. Stack-neutral obligation, and one of only two rules in this
  family that PORTS verbatim: the five patterns in the python-pytest sibling `coder.security.hardcoded-
  secret` are language-neutral, because `password = "..."` and a PEM header look identical in Python and
  TypeScript. Realized by `bun_security_hygiene_detector` (core alias SECURITY-HARDCODED-SECRET-001).

statement: >-
  A route handler for POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE MUST perform an authorisation check in its body. Stack-
  neutral obligation, RE-REALIZED for Bun: the python-pytest sibling matches a FastAPI decorator whose
  signature carries `Depends(get_current_user)`. Bun has neither decorators nor a DI container — routes
  are entries in the `routes` object of `Bun.serve` or branches of a `fetch` handler, and authorisation is
  an ordinary call. Realized by `bun_security_hygiene_detector` (core alias SECURITY-MISSING-AUTH-001).

statement: >-
  SQL passed to a query sink MUST NOT be built by interpolating a template literal or concatenating
  strings. Stack-neutral obligation, RE-REALIZED for Bun: the python-pytest sibling walks a Python AST for
  `execute` / `executemany` / `raw` / `execute_sql` and its own manifest scopes it "python stack only".
  Bun's sinks are `bun:sqlite` (`query` / `run` / `exec` / `prepare`), `Bun.sql` and the postgres/mysql
  clients. Realized by `bun_security_hygiene_detector` (core alias SECURITY-SQL-INJECTION-001).

statement: >-
  The object literal passed to an emit-like call naming a declared tracking-plan item MUST NOT
  carry a property the plan forbids on that item (REQUIRED).

statement: >-
  Every concrete telemetry item an acceptance requires MUST be bound to at least one non-test
  implementation source file by a `// Telemetry:` header (REQUIRED).

statement: >-
  An emit-like call (emit, emitted, track, capture, record, logEvent, emitEvent, sendEvent) whose
  first argument is a string literal naming an event MUST name an item declared in the tracking
  plan (REQUIRED).

statement: >-
  A `// Telemetry:` reference in implementation source names a concrete telemetry URN that resolves
  to a tracking-plan item under the telemetry root (REQUIRED).

statement: >-
  A layered source file outside the integration layer and infrastructure directories MUST NOT
  import a telemetry vendor SDK (REQUIRED).

statement: An app component (`.tsx`/`.jsx` outside the design root) MUST render interactive controls through a design-system
  primitive rather than a raw `<button>`, `<input>`, `<select>`, or `<textarea>`, so controls stay themed, accessible,
  and consistent. The same obligation covers controls authored as HTML in the bodies of string, template, and
  tagged-template literals in `.ts`/`.mts` files outside the design root — the shape an htmx/Bun server-rendered
  app writes. Bun realization of `coder.design.primitives`, mirroring `coder.vite.design-primitives`.

statement: Outside the tokens layer, a UI file (`.tsx`, `.jsx`, `.html`, `.htm`, `.css`) MUST NOT write a raw color
  literal — `#rgb`/`#rrggbb`/`#rrggbbaa`, `rgb()`/`rgba()`, `hsl()`/`hsla()` — in a CSS declaration, a `style` attribute,
  a `<style>` block, a JSX `style={{…}}` object, or a `fill`/`stroke`/`bgcolor` attribute. The same declarations are
  judged in inline `style="…"` attributes and `<style>` text authored in the HTML a `.ts`/`.mts` file renders from
  string/template/tagged-template literals. Colors come from tokens (`var(--…)`). Bun realization of
  `coder.design.token-color`, mirroring `coder.vite.design-token-color`.

statement: Outside the tokens layer, a UI file MUST NOT hardcode a spacing, inset, or border-radius length greater
  than 1px (`margin`, `padding`, `gap`, `inset`, `top`/`right`/`bottom`/`left`, `border-radius`), nor a non-zero
  duration in `transition`/`animation`. A bare number in a JSX style object for those properties counts as a length.
  The same declarations are judged in inline `style="…"` attributes and `<style>` text authored in the HTML a
  `.ts`/`.mts` file renders from string/template/tagged-template literals. These values come from foundations
  tokens. Bun realization of `coder.design.token-hardcoded` and of the raw-pixel part of `coder.design.foundations`.
